name: theme
title: Theme
description: BLProvider, ThemeScope and the appearance context: pick light/dark, a tint and a theme scope for a subtree. BLProvider is also the layer host its popups stay inside (useLayerHost), and a size-class scope: it measures its own box and provides compact / medium / regular to everything inside, which presentation="auto" popups follow. Colors are shadcn variables (see the bl-theme item for the iOS palette).
